name: Gamaliel
bio: Gamaliel, a Pharisee and respected teacher of the law, intervened when the council, enraged by Peter's preaching, wanted to kill the apostles. He urged caution, recalling earlier failed uprisings led by Theudas and Judas of Galilee, and reasoned that if the apostles' work were of men it would fail on its own, but if of God, the council would be fighting against God himself; his counsel prevailed, though the apostles were still beaten before being released (Acts 5:33-40). He later taught Saul of Tarsus, who would become the apostle Paul.
